description: Explore. On the E007 Muon incumbent, add a weight EMA that covers about the last epoch (decay about 0.99 per step at batch 2000, updated only in the final ~25% of steps). Also apply the EMA to the BN running statistics. Evaluate with the EMA weights. Run the EMA update as a single foreach op inside the compiled step. Reset the EMA in prepare.
